audit.whatIsWrong: Both chart layers read Skill/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Olaf/Olaf while the packet levelChart reads Fiora on six of seven rows, and the mirror audit has already written the opponent's page as Fiora on 0-3 and 5-6 with Skill at 6. Every one of my whys[] already describes Fiora winning those stages. The difficulty framing follows: 'Even matchup, 6/10' against a 10/10 carry threat and a chart she owns.

audit.corrected: Chart set to Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Fiora, Skill, Fiora, Fiora in BOTH layers as one atomic group, with ratings re-scaled and diff/tone/diffRating moved to TRICKY, 8/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as 'Ragnarok deletes CC — nothing he has stops the run-down', which overstates it against Fiora specifically.
audit.why: Riposte (24/22/20/18/16s) 'parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time'. Ragnarok grants immunity to disables and bonus armour and MR — it does not make your damage land through an active parry. So 6 is the even window the packet calls Skill, and it depends entirely on the parry being down, not on the ult being up.
audit.corrected: phases[4], whys[4], spikes[1] and mid rebuilt on the resists and the parry-down condition, with Riposte's 24s attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: THE CENTRAL CLAIM OF THE PAGE IS BACKWARDS. tldr, report[0], whys[0], whys[1], spikes[0], early and wants.foe[0] all say Fiora parries your E and STUNS you. Riposte only stuns if it blocked an IMMOBILIZING effect; otherwise the stab merely slows. Olaf's kit contains no immobilizing effect at all — Undertow slows, Reckless Swing is flat damage, Tough It Out is a shield, Ragnarok is a self-buff — so against Olaf a parried E can never produce a stun. Separately, 'Ragnarok cleanses her W stun' in whys[4], spikes[1], mid and wants.you[0] is doubly wrong: Ragnarok cleanses nothing, and there is no stun to cleanse.
audit.why: Riot text, Fiora W: 'parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, OR STUNS THEM IF FIORA BLOCKED AN IMMOBILIZING EFFECT WITH THIS ABILITY.' Riot text, Olaf's four abilities, none immobilizing. This flips the whole risk calculus of trading into a held parry: you lose the damage, not the fight.
audit.corrected: Every stun claim replaced with the slow, and the reason stated — you have no disable for her to block.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W omnivamp' in whys[3], early and wants.foe[2]. Olaf's W is Tough It Out — attack speed plus a shield, 16/15/14/13/12s.
audit.why: Riot text, Olaf W: 'Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.' The lifesteal is Berserker Rage (P). The mirror audit fixed four instances of the same retired-name error and explicitly left the prose blocks for a later pass; those are handled here.
audit.corrected: Shield and Berserker Rage named correctly in all three.

edits.before: This lane starts rough and you have to respect it: from level 1 her W-parry flips any trade you lead with — she stuns you off your own E and takes the exchange. Don't lead with the true damage. Farm with Undertow from range and only take short trades when you can bait or track her parry; if she's holding W, your Q+E burst gets blanked and she Q-dashes your flank for a free vital. Through 4-5 her parry timing and vital sustain beat your W omnivamp in extended trades, so treat levels 1-5 as damage control, not a lane to win.
edits.after: This lane starts rough and you have to respect it: from level 1 Riposte flips any trade you lead with — it parries the whole thing, eats your Reckless Swing and slows you off it. Don't lead with the true damage. Farm with Undertow from range and take short trades only when you can track her 24s parry; if she is holding W, your Q+E burst is blanked and she Q-dashes your flank for a free Vital. Through 4-5 her parry timing and Vital healing beat the Tough It Out shield in extended trades, so treat 1-5 as damage control, not a lane to win.

edits.before: Level 6 is your one genuinely even window — Ragnarok cleanses her W stun and her Q dash spacing, so a stuck Undertow slow into E true damage finally forces the melee all-in she normally kites. That's the play: bait her parry onto a Q or an auto first, then commit R while her W is down. Black Cleaver is your most oppressive point of the game — chain axe pickups to perma-slow her — but it's a snowball check, not a free win: if you haven't already built a lead, her first-item parry plus vitals still out-trade your spike, so cash this window hard.
edits.after: Level 6 is your one genuinely even window — Ragnarok's armour and MR turn her burst into a brawl, so a stuck Undertow slow into Reckless Swing finally forces the melee all-in she normally kites. That's the play: bait the parry onto a Q or an auto first, then commit R while her 24s W is down. Black Cleaver is your most oppressive point of the game — chain axe pickups to perma-slow her — but it's a snowball check, not a free win: without a lead already banked, her first-item parry plus Vitals still out-trade your spike.

notes: The stun/slow distinction on Riposte is the highest-value fix in this slice and it is worth propagating: any Olaf page that tells the player Fiora stuns him off a parried ability is wrong, because Olaf has no immobilizing effect anywhere in his kit. dosFull[1].t 'R to ignore her Riposte stun' carries the same error but is 28 characters of near-boilerplate; I left it rather than spend a chart-adjacent edit on it — worth a manual fix alongside the same field on other champions. Olaf's Undertow (Q) carries a derived 'grounding' flag Riot's description does not support; no grounding claim was made against her Q dash.
